boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Dominican University
boards.description: Navigate the late-night food scene near Dominican University's River Forest campus, featuring on-campus mobile ordering and local Chicago-style staples open past midnight.

cards.title: DU To Go at Mazzuchelli Hall
cards.subtitle: On-Campus Late Dining
cards.notes: Order through the mobile app for late-night meals on campus. It serves as the primary evening dining option for students after the main hall closes.
cards.short_summary: DU To Go is the university's official mobile-ordering dining service for late-night meals.
cards.evidence_claim: DU To Go operates until 9:00 PM Monday through Thursday and until 8:00 PM Friday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: Dominican University Dining
cards.access_notes: Open until 9:00 PM Mon-Thu; 8:00 PM Fri-Sun. Requires DU Dollars or meal plan.

cards.title: Johnnie's Beef
cards.subtitle: Midnight Italian Beef
cards.notes: Visit this cash-only landmark for a 'juicy' Italian beef or homemade lemon ice. The line moves fast even during late-night rushes.
cards.short_summary: A legendary cash-only stand famous for Italian beef and charcoal-grilled snacks open until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Johnnie's Beef is open Monday through Saturday from 11:00 AM to midnight and Sunday from noon to midnight.
cards.source_title: Johnnie's Beef - Explore Oak Park and Beyond
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight daily. Cash only.

cards.title: Gene & Jude's
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Depression Dogs
cards.notes: Stop by for a classic hot dog with hand-cut fries piled on top. Remember the house rule: no ketchup allowed on the premises.
cards.short_summary: An iconic no-frills hot dog stand serving 'Depression Dogs' until 1:00 AM or later.
cards.evidence_claim: Gene & Jude's is open until 1:00 AM Sunday through Thursday and until 2:00 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Gene and Jude's | Voted Best Hot Dog in the United States
cards.access_notes: Open until 1:00 AM (Sun-Thu) and 2:00 AM (Fri-Sat). No seating available.

cards.title: Portillo's Forest Park
cards.subtitle: 1 AM Chocolate Cake Shakes
cards.notes: Head to the drive-thru for a late-night chocolate cake shake or a Maxwell Street Polish. The 50s-themed diner is a local favorite.
cards.short_summary: A Chicago-style fast-food chain known for hot dogs and Italian beef, featuring a late-night drive-thru.
cards.evidence_claim: Portillo's Forest Park is open until 1:00 AM every day for both restaurant and drive-thru service.
cards.source_title: Portillo's Forest Park
cards.access_notes: Open until 1:00 AM daily. Drive-thru and kiosk ordering available.

cards.title: Dunkin' Elmwood Park
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Coffee & Donuts
cards.notes: Grab a coffee or a box of donuts at any hour. This location is a reliable 24/7 spot for students pulling all-nighters.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour coffee and baked goods shop located just north of the university campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dunkin' at 7201 W Grand Ave in Elmwood Park is open 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
cards.source_title: Dunkin' at 7201 W Grand Ave in Elmwood Park
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily. Features a drive-thru and free WiFi.

cards.title: McDonald's River Forest
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Fast Food
cards.notes: Visit this modernized location for a quick late-night burger or fries. It is a frequent stop for students due to its proximity to campus.
cards.short_summary: A standard fast-food destination near campus with extended evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The McDonald's at 626 N Harlem Ave is open for dinner service until 11:30 PM.
cards.source_title: Order McDonald's® (Harlem & Oak) Menu Delivery in River Forest - Uber Eats
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:30 PM daily. Drive-thru available.

cards.title: Taco Bell Forest Park
cards.subtitle: 3 AM Taco Runs
cards.notes: Drive south to Harlem Avenue for late-night tacos and burritos. This location stays open much later than the on-campus options.
cards.short_summary: A popular late-night fast-food chain serving Mexican-inspired fare until 3:00 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: The Taco Bell at 161 S Harlem Ave in Forest Park is open until 3:00 AM.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell® in Melrose Park, IL - 825 W North Ave
cards.access_notes: Open until 3:00 AM daily. Drive-thru available.

cards.title: 7-Eleven River Forest
cards.subtitle: 24/7 Convenience
cards.notes: Pick up snacks, drinks, or basic groceries at any hour. This convenience store is the closest 24-hour retail option to the university.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience store providing snacks and essentials for late-night study sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: The 7-Eleven at 1140 N Harlem Avenue in River Forest is a 24-hour convenience store.
cards.source_title: 1140 N Harlem Avenue River Forest IL 60305-1524 - 7-Eleven
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Cookie Delivery
cards.notes: Order warm cookies for delivery to your dorm until 3:00 AM. It is a staple for late-night sugar cravings during finals week.
cards.short_summary: A bakery specializing in delivering warm cookies and brownies late into the night.
cards.evidence_claim: Insomnia Cookies delivers warm treats daily until 3:00 AM.
cards.source_title: Insomnia Cookies (@insomniacookies) - Facebook
cards.access_notes: Delivery available until 3:00 AM daily.

cards.title: Jim & Pete's
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Pizza & Pasta
cards.notes: Enjoy a late-night thin-crust pizza or pasta dish. This family-owned Italian restaurant has been a local fixture since 1941.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing Italian restaurant offering pizza and pasta with late evening hours on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Jim & Pete's is open until 10:00 PM Sunday through Thursday and until 11:00 PM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Jim & Pete's - Explore Oak Park and Beyond
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 PM (Sun-Thu) and 11:00 PM (Fri-Sat).

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the functional student spaces and quiet corners of Dominican University's River Forest campus that go beyond the standard tour highlights.

cards.title: Study in the Noonan Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Mazzuchelli Hall, Second Floor
cards.notes: Visit this quiet, wood-paneled hall for focused study sessions. It is located on the second floor of Mazzuchelli Hall and offers a traditional library atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: A historic, quiet study hall located on the second floor of Mazzuchelli Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Noonan Reading Room is described as a perfect atmosphere to read and do homework, located on the second floor of Lewis Hall/Mazzuchelli complex.
cards.source_title: Get Involved on Campus | Dominican University
cards.access_notes: Open to students during building hours; often used for quiet individual study.

cards.title: Relax at The Underground
cards.subtitle: Power Hall, Lower Level
cards.notes: Head to the lower level of Power Hall to play pool or lounge with friends. This social hub is a primary spot for student relaxation between classes.
cards.short_summary: A student social lounge and game room located in the lower level of Power Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Underground is a place to hang out with friends, featuring a variety of games and spaces to relax in the lower level of Power Hall.
cards.source_title: Get Involved on Campus | Dominican University
cards.access_notes: Accessible to students with a valid Star Card during operational hours.

cards.title: Work at the L-Stop
cards.subtitle: Power Hall, First Floor
cards.notes: Utilize this mixed-use space for both social interaction and productivity. It is located on the first floor of Power Hall near the bookstore.
cards.short_summary: A student lounge and workspace located on the first floor of Power Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The L-Stop is described as a great mix for students who like getting work done and is located in Power Hall.
cards.source_title: Get Involved on Campus | Dominican University
cards.access_notes: Open during Power Hall building hours; no reservation required.

cards.title: Gather in the Parmer Atrium
cards.subtitle: Parmer Hall, First Floor
cards.notes: Meet in this bright, multi-story atrium for group projects or a quick break. It serves as the central hub of the science and health building.
cards.short_summary: The central glass-walled atrium of Parmer Hall used for student gathering.
cards.evidence_claim: The Shaffer Silveri Atrium is located on the first floor of Parmer Hall and is a recognized space for study and gathering.
cards.source_title: Dominican University Main Campus Map
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible during Parmer Hall's standard academic hours.

cards.title: Reserve a Private Study Room
cards.subtitle: Rebecca Crown Library, Floors 1 & 2
cards.notes: Book a room online for group collaboration or quiet focus. Rooms are equipped with whiteboards and monitors for student use.
cards.short_summary: Reservable group and individual study rooms within the Rebecca Crown Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The library offers reservable study rooms on the first and second floors, bookable through the LibCal system.
cards.source_title: Space Availability - Crown First Floor Study Rooms
cards.access_notes: Reservations required via the library's online portal; available during library hours.

cards.title: Study in the Lewis Alcove
cards.subtitle: Lewis Memorial Hall, First Floor
cards.notes: Find a seat in the recently renovated alcove for a quick study session. This space features modern furniture and is near the main campus entrance.
cards.short_summary: A renovated common study area located on the first floor of Lewis Memorial Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lewis Alcove was refreshed with new furniture and is intended for students to sit, study, and stay.
cards.source_title: Lewis First Floor Renovated for DU | Dominican Star Newspaper
cards.access_notes: Open to all students during Lewis Hall operational hours.

cards.title: Run the Collins Track
cards.subtitle: Igini Sports Forum, Second Floor
cards.notes: Access the indoor elevated track for year-round exercise. It overlooks the Igini Sports Forum and is open to the campus community.
cards.short_summary: An indoor elevated running track located on the second floor of the Igini Sports Forum.
cards.evidence_claim: The Collins Running Track is located on the second floor of the Igini Sports Forum and is listed as an athletic facility for student use.
cards.source_title: Support Your Health | Dominican University
cards.access_notes: Open during Igini Sports Forum hours; requires a valid Star Card for entry.

cards.title: Visit the DU Feeds Pantry
cards.subtitle: Mazzuchelli Hall, Room 276
cards.notes: Access healthy food options at no cost if you are experiencing food insecurity. This student resource is located on the second floor of Mazzuchelli Hall.
cards.short_summary: The on-campus food pantry providing resources to students in need.
cards.evidence_claim: DU Feeds is the university's on-campus food pantry located in Mazzuchelli 276.
cards.source_title: Support Your Health | Dominican University
cards.access_notes: Available to all students; check university website for current pantry hours.

cards.title: Connect in the Social Hall
cards.subtitle: Mazzuchelli Hall, First Floor
cards.notes: Use this large common area for informal meetings or studying. It is centrally located on the first floor of Mazzuchelli Hall near the dining area.
cards.short_summary: A large multi-purpose student common area in Mazzuchelli Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Social Hall is listed as a student space on the first floor of Mazzuchelli Hall, used for gathering and study.
cards.source_title: Dominican University Main Campus Map
cards.access_notes: Open during standard building hours; no reservation required.

cards.title: Utilize the SIRC Supplies
cards.subtitle: Mazzuchelli Hall
cards.notes: Access art supplies, board games, and club resources in this dedicated center. It is the primary hub for student organization planning and materials.
cards.short_summary: A resource center for student clubs and organizations to access supplies and games.
cards.evidence_claim: The SIRC provides student clubs with access to supplies, board games, and art supplies for events.
cards.source_title: Get Involved on Campus | Dominican University
cards.access_notes: Open to all students and club leaders during operational hours.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Discover the best social spaces and activities at Dominican University that require no admission fee or purchase, from historic reading rooms to outdoor concerts.

cards.title: Study in the Noonan Reading Room
cards.subtitle: A historic quiet space in Lewis Hall
cards.notes: Visit the second floor of Lewis Hall to study in this classic, wood-paneled room. It is a designated quiet zone perfect for focused reading or homework between classes.
cards.short_summary: The Noonan Reading Room is a historic, quiet study space located on the second floor of Lewis Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Noonan Reading Room is described as a perfect atmosphere to read and do homework, located on the second floor of Lewis Hall, and is listed as a study area available to students.
cards.source_title: Get Involved on Campus | Dominican University
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; accessible to all students for quiet study.

cards.title: Browse the O'Connor Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Contemporary art on the fourth floor of Lewis Hall
cards.notes: Explore rotating contemporary art exhibitions and annual student shows. The gallery is free and open to the public Monday through Friday from 10:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.
cards.short_summary: The O'Connor Art Gallery hosts contemporary art exhibitions and is free and open to the public.
cards.evidence_claim: The gallery is open to the public during the academic year, Monday–Friday, 10:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m., and is free for all visitors.
cards.source_title: O'Connor Art Gallery | Dominican University
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 10am-5pm; Saturday by appointment.

cards.title: Reflect at the Grotto
cards.subtitle: A peaceful outdoor retreat since 1929
cards.notes: Find a quiet moment at this historic stone grotto in the northwest corner of campus. It features a waterfall, seating, and a statue of St. Bernadette.
cards.short_summary: The Our Lady of Lourdes Grotto is a historic outdoor space for prayer and reflection on the River Forest campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Grotto is a place of prayer, reflection, and peace for the university community and neighborhood, featuring new plantings and a brick platform for benches.
cards.source_title: The Grotto: A Place of Prayer and Peace for Nearly a Century | Dominican University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public space accessible year-round.

cards.title: Attend a Summer Sounds Concert
cards.subtitle: Free outdoor music on the Quad
cards.notes: Bring a blanket to the Quad on Wednesday nights during the summer for free live music. Performances range from Latin jazz to 90s tribute bands.
cards.short_summary: Summer Sounds is a series of free weekly outdoor concerts held on the Dominican University Quad.
cards.evidence_claim: Summer Sounds '26 features free music every Wednesday from June 10 to August 12 on the quad, weather permitting.
cards.source_title: Summer Sounds '26 | Dominican University
cards.access_notes: Wednesdays at 7:00 pm during the summer season.

cards.title: Celebrate at DU Fest
cards.subtitle: Annual back-to-school festival on the Quad
cards.notes: Join the campus community on the Quad for this annual festival featuring food trucks, live music, and free activities to kick off the academic year.
cards.short_summary: DU Fest is a free annual festival for students held on the Quad during Welcome Weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: DU Fest is a free event for all DU Students on the Quad, including food trucks, live music, and free activities.
cards.source_title: Welcome Weekend - River Forest Campus | Dominican University
cards.access_notes: Held annually on the Sunday afternoon of Welcome Weekend.

cards.title: Hang Out in the Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Social and study hub in the library
cards.notes: Use the first and second floors of the library for group study or social gathering. The space includes reservable study rooms and comfortable seating.
cards.short_summary: The Learning Commons in the Rebecca Crown Library provides social and gathering spaces for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Learning Commons houses centralized services, study rooms, social and gathering spaces on the 1st and 2nd floors of the library.
cards.source_title: Get Involved on Campus | Dominican University
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; Star Card required for some services.

cards.title: Relax in the Parmer Hall Atrium
cards.subtitle: Modern light-filled space in Parmer Hall
cards.notes: Gather in this central atrium that overlooks a courtyard. It serves as a hub for the science departments and offers a bright space for student connection.
cards.short_summary: The Shaffer Silveri Atrium is a central gathering space within Parmer Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Parmer Hall features the Shaffer Silveri Atrium on the first floor, which overlooks a courtyard and serves as a central hub.
cards.source_title: Dominican University Main Campus
cards.access_notes: Open during academic building hours.

cards.title: Watch a Show at Lund Auditorium
cards.subtitle: Free tickets for Dominican students
cards.notes: Claim up to two free tickets for university-presented performing arts or theatre shows. Shows include musical acts, dance parties, and mariachi performances.
cards.short_summary: Dominican University students receive free admission to most Performing Arts Center events.
cards.evidence_claim: DU Students are entitled to 2 free tickets per DU Performing Arts or Theatre Arts Show at the Lund Auditorium.
cards.source_title: Ticket Services | Dominican University
cards.access_notes: Student ID required; tickets must be reserved through the box office.

cards.title: Join the Día de los Muertos Procession
cards.subtitle: Annual cultural celebration and ofrendas
cards.notes: Participate in the annual procession with mariachis to bless campus ofrendas. The event concludes with a convivencia, a festive shared meal.
cards.short_summary: The Día de los Muertos celebration is an annual campus event featuring processions and community altars.
cards.evidence_claim: Dominican gathers each year for a Día de los Muertos celebration with a procession, mariachis, and a convivencia sharing a meal.
cards.source_title: Cultural and Heritage Events | Dominican University
cards.access_notes: Annual event held in late October or early November.

cards.title: Work Out at the Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: Free gym access for students in Power Hall
cards.notes: Access 3,300 square feet of cardio and weight equipment in Power Hall. Entry is free for all current students with a valid Dominican Star Card.
cards.short_summary: The Fitness Center in Power Hall offers free gym access to the Dominican University community.
cards.evidence_claim: The facility is open to all current Dominican University students, faculty, staff, and alums; a current Dominican University ID must be shown.
cards.source_title: Fitness Center - Facilities - Dominican University Athletics
cards.access_notes: Open during posted hours; Star Card required for entry.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Discover the best environments for focused academic work at Dominican University, from quiet reading rooms to collaborative tech-enabled spaces.

cards.title: Noonan Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Mazzuchelli Hall, Second Floor
cards.notes: Find a quiet, traditional atmosphere for deep focus. This room is located on the second floor of Mazzuchelli Hall and offers a classic academic setting.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, traditional reading room located on the second floor of Mazzuchelli Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Noonan Reading Room is located on the second floor of Mazzuchelli Hall and is described as a perfect atmosphere for reading and homework.
cards.source_title: Get Involved on Campus | Dominican University
cards.access_notes: Open to all students; typically follows standard academic building hours.

cards.title: Crown First Floor Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Rebecca Crown Library, First Floor
cards.notes: Reserve one of the four group rooms (120-123) for collaborative projects. Each room has a capacity of four people and can be booked online.
cards.short_summary: Reservable group study rooms located on the first floor of the Rebecca Crown Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The library offers reservable spaces Crown 120, 121, 122, and 123 on the first floor with a capacity of 4 people each.
cards.source_title: Space Availability - Crown First Floor Study Rooms - LibCal - Dominican University
cards.access_notes: Reservations required through LibCal; rooms accommodate up to 4 people.

cards.title: Crown Second Floor Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Rebecca Crown Library, Second Floor
cards.notes: Book rooms 204-212 for group sessions. These spaces are part of the Learning Commons and provide a hub for student collaboration.
cards.short_summary: A collection of reservable group study rooms on the second floor of the library.
cards.evidence_claim: The second floor of Rebecca Crown Library features multiple reservable study rooms including 204, 205, 206, 207, 208, 210, 211, and 212.
cards.source_title: Space Availability - Crown Second Floor Study Rooms - LibCal - Dominican University
cards.access_notes: Online reservation required; capacity varies by room (typically 4 people).

cards.title: Parmer Atrium
cards.subtitle: Parmer Hall, Main Level
cards.notes: Study in a bright, modern environment with natural light. The atrium and upper floor study areas offer a more open feel than the library.
cards.short_summary: A modern, light-filled study area located in the central atrium of Parmer Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Parmer Atrium and study areas on floors 2 and 3 are listed as available campus study spaces.
cards.source_title: Where can I study or take an online class on campus? - Support Center
cards.access_notes: Open during Parmer Hall building hours; no reservation needed for open atrium seating.

cards.title: Lewis Technology Center
cards.subtitle: Lewis Hall, Lower Level
cards.notes: Access computers and tech support while you work. This lower-level space is ideal for students needing specific software or IT assistance.
cards.short_summary: A tech-focused study space with computer access located in the lower level of Lewis Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lewis Hall lower level Technology Center is designated as a space for study and online classes.
cards.source_title: Where can I study or take an online class on campus? - Support Center
cards.access_notes: Available during IT Support Center hours; Monday-Thursday until 7:00pm.

cards.title: The Underground
cards.subtitle: Mazzuchelli Hall, Lower Level
cards.notes: Utilize this lower-level space for a more casual study environment. It is one of the designated areas for students to take online classes.
cards.short_summary: A casual study and lounge area located in the lower level of Mazzuchelli Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Underground is listed as an available campus space for study or attending online classes.
cards.source_title: Where can I study or take an online class on campus? - Support Center
cards.access_notes: Open to all students; accessible via the stairwell in Lewis Hall or Mazzuchelli.

cards.title: Lewis Hall Alcove
cards.subtitle: Lewis Hall, First Floor
cards.notes: Take advantage of the recently renovated common space in the Lewis Hall Alcove. It features new furniture designed for students to sit and study.
cards.short_summary: A newly renovated common study area on the first floor of Lewis Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lewis Alcove was renovated with new furniture to serve as a common space for students to sit and study.
cards.source_title: Lewis First Floor Renovated for DU | Dominican Star Newspaper
cards.access_notes: Public common area; no reservation required.

cards.title: Coughlin Commons Lounges
cards.subtitle: Coughlin Hall, First Floor
cards.notes: Residents can use the two comfortable community lounges for solo study or collaboration. These spaces are designed to foster a supportive academic environment.
cards.short_summary: Study lounges located within the Coughlin Hall residence for student use.
cards.evidence_claim: Coughlin Hall features two community lounges perfect for studying solo or collaborating with classmates.
cards.source_title: Residence Halls | Dominican University
cards.access_notes: Primary access for residents; common areas may have restricted guest policies.

cards.title: Library Recording Studio
cards.subtitle: Rebecca Crown Library, Lower Level
cards.notes: Use this specialized space for creative projects or media-based assignments. It is part of the Learning Commons and can be reserved online.
cards.short_summary: A reservable recording studio for creative and academic media projects.
cards.evidence_claim: The lower level of the library houses a recording studio that is available for student use and can be booked via LibCal.
cards.source_title: Space Availability - Recording Studio - LibCal - Dominican University
cards.access_notes: Reservation required; specifically for recording and media production.

cards.title: Social Hall
cards.subtitle: Mazzuchelli Hall, First Floor
cards.notes: Find a spot in this large, multi-purpose space. It is often used for events but serves as an available study area during quiet periods.
cards.short_summary: A large multi-purpose hall on the first floor of Mazzuchelli Hall used for study.
cards.evidence_claim: The Social Hall is listed as one of the campus spaces available for students to study or take online classes.
cards.source_title: Where can I study or take an online class on campus? - Support Center
cards.access_notes: Open to all students; availability may be limited during scheduled university events.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Explore the corridors and micro-districts surrounding Dominican University's River Forest campus, from local pizza institutions to transit-connected shopping hubs.

cards.title: Bertolli's River Pizza
cards.subtitle: Lake Street & Thatcher Avenue
cards.notes: Visit this family-run institution for classic thin-crust or deep-dish pizza. It is a local staple located just a short walk from the River Forest Metra station.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing family-run pizzeria on Lake Street known for authentic Italian recipes and proximity to the Metra.
cards.evidence_claim: Bertolli's River Pizza is located at 7973 West Lake Street and has been family-run since 1981, serving as a local institution near the Metra station.
cards.source_title: River Forest Business Spotlight: Showcasing Local Businesses and Entrepreneurs
cards.access_notes: Open daily for dine-in and carry-out; check website for specific evening hours.

cards.title: Fresh Thyme Market
cards.subtitle: North Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Stock up on fresh produce and natural groceries at this major retail anchor on the North Avenue commercial strip bordering River Forest.
cards.short_summary: A large grocery store on North Avenue providing fresh food options for students living off-campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Fresh Thyme is located at 7501 North Ave in River Forest and is listed as a major grocery store in the local business directory.
cards.source_title: Fresh Thyme Market - River Forest
cards.access_notes: Standard grocery store hours; typically open until 9:00 PM or 10:00 PM daily.

cards.title: River Forest Town Center
cards.subtitle: Lake Street & Harlem Avenue
cards.notes: Browse national retailers like Loft and Chico's at this central shopping hub located at the intersection of River Forest and Oak Park.
cards.short_summary: A prominent retail center on Lake Street featuring a variety of fashion boutiques and essential services.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town Center is described as the heart of shopping in River Forest, featuring stores like Chico's and Loft at Lake Street and Harlem Avenue.
cards.source_title: 11 Best Places to Shop in River Forest
cards.access_notes: Public shopping center with individual store hours; generally accessible during daylight and early evening.

cards.title: Madison Street Commons
cards.subtitle: Madison Street Corridor
cards.notes: Walk through this vibrant mixed-use area in Forest Park, which features ground-floor commercial spaces and is a popular residential spot for students.
cards.short_summary: A modern mixed-use development on Madison Street that serves as a hub for local dining and student housing.
cards.evidence_claim: Madison Street Commons is a four-story mixed-use building on Madison Street, located within 5 minutes of the university area.
cards.source_title: Madison Street Commons - Forest Park, IL
cards.access_notes: Public sidewalk access to commercial storefronts; residential areas are private.

cards.title: Marion Street District
cards.subtitle: North Marion Street, Oak Park
cards.notes: Experience the brick-paved streets of downtown Oak Park, home to the Little Gem Cafe and various upscale dining and wellness services.
cards.short_summary: A pedestrian-friendly district in nearby Oak Park offering a dense collection of restaurants and shops.
cards.evidence_claim: Marion Street in Downtown Oak Park features numerous dining options like Little Gem Cafe and Breakfast House Oak Park.
cards.source_title: Dining - Downtown Oak Park
cards.access_notes: Public street; most businesses close by 10:00 PM or 11:00 PM.

cards.title: CAVA River Forest
cards.subtitle: Lake Street Dining Strip
cards.notes: Grab a Mediterranean bowl at this popular fast-casual spot on Lake Street, which offers late-night dining until 10:00 PM daily.
cards.short_summary: A modern Mediterranean restaurant on Lake Street providing healthy, quick meals for the campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: CAVA is located at 7211 Lake Street in River Forest and is open until 10:00 PM every night.
cards.source_title: CAVA at 7211 Lake Street in River Forest, IL
cards.access_notes: Open daily 10:30 AM to 10:00 PM; offers pickup and delivery.

cards.title: Yolk River Forest
cards.subtitle: North Avenue & Lathrop
cards.notes: Enjoy a classic brunch at this former site of Grandma Sally's. It is a well-known spot for breakfast scramblers and pancakes on the North Avenue corridor.
cards.short_summary: A popular breakfast and brunch destination on North Avenue known for its extensive egg-based menu.
cards.evidence_claim: Yolk is located at 7301 West North Avenue and was formerly the site of Grandma Sally's diner.
cards.source_title: Yolk - River Forest
cards.access_notes: Open daily for breakfast and lunch; typically closes by 3:00 PM.

cards.title: Lathrop House Cafe
cards.subtitle: Lathrop Avenue, Forest Park
cards.notes: Visit this converted residential house for coffee and sandwiches. It is a unique local eatery located just south of the River Forest border.
cards.short_summary: A charming cafe set in a historic house on Lathrop Avenue, offering a cozy atmosphere for coffee and light meals.
cards.evidence_claim: Lathrop House Cafe is located at 26 Lathrop Ave in Forest Park, occupying a dually zoned residential property.
cards.source_title: Former Blue Max to become Lathrop House Cafe
cards.access_notes: Daytime cafe hours; check local listings for seasonal changes.

cards.title: Good Earth Greenhouse
cards.subtitle: Madison Street & Thatcher
cards.notes: Explore this serene garden center on Madison Street, which reflects the verdant, tree-lined character of the River Forest community.
cards.short_summary: A local greenhouse and garden center on Madison Street known for its lush plant selection and community presence.
cards.evidence_claim: Good Earth Greenhouse is located at 7900 West Madison Street and is highlighted as a notable local business in River Forest.
cards.source_title: Good Earth Greenhouse & Cafe
cards.access_notes: Open daily; includes a cafe on-site with seasonal hours.

cards.title: La Parrillita Mexican Grill
cards.subtitle: North Avenue & Harlem
cards.notes: Stop by for fresh tamales, tacos, and burritos at this Mexican grill located on the busy North Avenue commercial corridor.
cards.short_summary: A casual Mexican restaurant on North Avenue offering fresh daily specials and authentic flavors.
cards.evidence_claim: La Parrillita Mexican Grill is located at 7225 W North Ave in River Forest and is known for fresh tamales and tacos.
cards.source_title: La Parrillita Mexican Grill
cards.access_notes: Open daily for lunch and dinner; free parking is available in the back.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Discover the unique rituals and long-standing traditions that define the student experience at Dominican University, from historic candlelight processions to modern community celebrations.

cards.title: Candle and Rose Ceremony
cards.subtitle: A pre-commencement ritual of light and love
cards.notes: Since 1928, seniors carry lit candles (Veritas) and exchange them for roses (Caritas) with a chosen partner on the Cloister Walk.
cards.short_summary: A historic pre-graduation ceremony where seniors exchange symbolic candles and roses with mentors or peers.
cards.evidence_claim: The first Candle and Rose ceremony was held in 1928, encouraged by Sr. Constanza; it involves seniors processing with candles and receiving roses from partners.
cards.source_title: So Proudly Dominican: Traditions at DU
cards.access_notes: Held annually on the evening before Commencement in the Quadrangle.

cards.title: Caritas Veritas Symposium
cards.subtitle: Annual day of mission-centered scholarship
cards.notes: Classes are suspended for a day each fall so the entire community can present and attend workshops on the university's motto.
cards.short_summary: An annual fall symposium where the university community explores the themes of 'Charity and Truth' through presentations.
cards.evidence_claim: The Caritas Veritas Symposium is an annual tradition where regular classes are suspended for a day of community presentations and workshops.
cards.source_title: Caritas Veritas Symposium | Dominican University
cards.access_notes: Open to all students, faculty, and staff; typically held in November.

cards.title: Our Lady of Lourdes Grotto
cards.subtitle: A century-old site for prayer and reflection
cards.notes: Built in 1929, this replica grotto serves as a quiet space for prayer and is the site of the annual Rosary Sunday celebration.
cards.short_summary: A historic campus grotto used for both private reflection and communal traditions like the candlelight Día de los Muertos procession.
cards.evidence_claim: The Grotto was a gift from the Class of 1928, modeled after the Sanctuary in France, and has been a place of prayer since 1929.
cards.source_title: The Grotto: A Place of Prayer and Peace for Nearly a Century
cards.access_notes: Located in the northwest corner of the River Forest campus; accessible year-round.

cards.title: Mazzuchelli Day
cards.subtitle: Celebrating the university's founder
cards.notes: Observed on November 4th, this day honors Fr. Samuel Mazzuchelli with lectures, special Masses, and community cupcakes.
cards.short_summary: A founder's day celebration held every November to honor the legacy of Fr. Samuel Mazzuchelli.
cards.evidence_claim: Founder's Day commemorates the birth of Fr. Samuel Mazzuchelli on Nov. 4 with traditions including special Masses and cupcakes in the Social Hall.
cards.source_title: So Proudly Dominican: Traditions at DU
cards.access_notes: Events take place across campus, particularly in the Social Hall and Rosary Chapel.

cards.title: Día de los Muertos Procession
cards.subtitle: A cultural celebration of remembrance
cards.notes: Students create ofrendas across campus and participate in a mariachi-led procession to bless the altars each November.
cards.short_summary: An annual cultural tradition featuring campus-wide altars and a musical procession to honor ancestors.
cards.evidence_claim: Dominican hosts an annual Día de los Muertos celebration with ofrendas around campus and a procession with mariachis.
cards.source_title: Cultural and Heritage Events | Dominican University
cards.access_notes: Procession typically moves through campus buildings and ends at a community meal.

cards.title: Las Posadas
cards.subtitle: A festive Christmas journey on campus
cards.notes: This tradition reenacts Mary and Joseph's search for shelter with caroling, piñatas, and a procession through campus buildings.
cards.short_summary: A holiday tradition involving a musical procession and community gathering to celebrate hospitality.
cards.evidence_claim: Dominican hosts on-campus posadas with a procession through campus, singing traditional songs and breaking piñatas.
cards.source_title: Cultural and Heritage Events | Dominican University
cards.access_notes: Held annually in December; open to the university community.

cards.title: Casino Night
cards.subtitle: A high-stakes night for non-monetary prizes
cards.notes: A student favorite for over 20 years, this spring event features poker and roulette with prizes instead of cash.
cards.short_summary: An annual spring social event hosted by the Campus Activities Board featuring casino-style games.
cards.evidence_claim: Casino Night has been a tradition at Dominican since the early 2000s, featuring games like Poker and Blackjack for non-monetary prizes.
cards.source_title: College Student Gambling | Dominican Star Newspaper
cards.access_notes: Typically held in the spring; open to all students.

cards.title: Scholarship and Ideas Expo
cards.subtitle: Showcasing student research and creativity
cards.notes: This day-long spring event invites students to present research posters and course projects to the campus community.
cards.short_summary: An annual spring tradition celebrating student academic achievement through public presentations.
cards.evidence_claim: The (SI) Scholarship and Ideas Expo has become an annual tradition since 2009, showcasing student research and outcomes.
cards.source_title: So Proudly Dominican: Traditions at DU
cards.access_notes: Held annually in the spring; presentations occur across various campus buildings.

cards.title: Summer Sounds on the Quad
cards.subtitle: Weekly community concerts under the stars
cards.notes: Every Wednesday night in summer, the university hosts free outdoor concerts on the Quad for students and neighbors.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing summer concert series that brings the local community to the campus Quad.
cards.evidence_claim: Summer Sounds is a series of weekly free concerts held on the Quad every Wednesday night from June to August.
cards.source_title: Summer Sounds '26 | Dominican University
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public; weather dependent.

cards.title: Founding Sisters Heritage Exhibit
cards.subtitle: Honoring the Sinsinawa Dominican legacy
cards.notes: A permanent display in the Noonan Reading Room featuring illuminated panels that tell the stories of the university's founders.
cards.short_summary: A permanent campus exhibit dedicated to the history and impact of the Sinsinawa Dominican Sisters.
cards.evidence_claim: The Heritage Exhibit of illuminated panels is on permanent display in the Noonan Reading Room to honor the legacy of the Sisters.
cards.source_title: Dominican University - Founding Sisters Exhibit
cards.access_notes: Located inside the Noonan Reading Room; accessible during library hours.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Dominican University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: Navigate your first few days at Dominican University with this sequence of essential campus stops and community traditions during Welcome Weekend.

cards.title: Settle Into Your New Home
cards.subtitle: Friday Morning: Move-In Day
cards.notes: Check in at your assigned residence hall to receive your keys and start unpacking. Staff and student leaders are available to help you navigate the buildings.
cards.short_summary: The official start of Welcome Weekend begins with residence hall move-in for new students.
cards.evidence_claim: Welcome Weekend starts on Friday, August 21 with residence hall move-in from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM.
cards.source_title: Welcome Weekend Schedule at a Glance - Dominican University
cards.access_notes: Restricted to residential students and their guests during move-in hours.

cards.title: Connect with Campus Resources
cards.subtitle: Friday Midday: Resource Fair
cards.notes: Visit the Move-In Fair to meet representatives from various campus departments and pick up essential information for your first semester.
cards.short_summary: A midday fair providing new students with direct access to university resources and support services.
cards.evidence_claim: A Move-In Fair is held on Friday from 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM for students to connect with campus resources.
cards.source_title: Welcome Weekend Schedule at a Glance - Dominican University
cards.access_notes: Open to all new students and their families during Welcome Weekend.

cards.title: Meet Your New Neighbors
cards.subtitle: Friday Evening: Social Mixer
cards.notes: Join fellow first-year students for a casual ice cream social to end your first day on campus and start building new friendships.
cards.short_summary: An evening social event designed for new students to mingle and meet their peers in a relaxed setting.
cards.evidence_claim: Evening activities on the first day of Welcome Weekend include an Ice Cream Social and floor meetings.
cards.source_title: Welcome Weekend Schedule at a Glance - Dominican University
cards.access_notes: Open to all new students participating in Welcome Weekend.

cards.title: Explore the River Forest Campus
cards.subtitle: Saturday Morning: Self-Guided Tour
cards.notes: Participate in a self-guided showcase to find your classrooms, study spots, and key administrative offices before classes begin.
cards.short_summary: A designated time for students to familiarize themselves with the physical layout of the campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Saturday programming includes a self-guided campus discovery showcase from 10:30 AM to 12:30 PM.
cards.source_title: Welcome Weekend Schedule at a Glance - Dominican University
cards.access_notes: Open to all students and their families.

cards.title: Lunch with the Community
cards.subtitle: Saturday Afternoon: Community Meal
cards.notes: Gather with other new students and families for a community barbecue to celebrate the start of your university journey.
cards.short_summary: A community-wide lunch event held on the second day of Welcome Weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: A New Beginnings BBQ is scheduled for Saturday from 12:30 PM to 2:00 PM.
cards.source_title: Welcome Weekend Schedule at a Glance - Dominican University
cards.access_notes: Open to new students and their guests.

cards.title: Watch a Film Under the Stars
cards.subtitle: Saturday Night: SGA Movie
cards.notes: Relax on the Quad for an outdoor movie hosted by the Student Government Association, a perfect way to unwind after a busy day.
cards.short_summary: An evening entertainment event hosted by the SGA on the campus Quad.
cards.evidence_claim: An outdoor movie night hosted by the Student Government Association is held on Saturday at 7:30 PM.
cards.source_title: Welcome Weekend Schedule at a Glance - Dominican University
cards.access_notes: Open to all Dominican University students.

cards.title: Celebrate at the Campus Festival
cards.subtitle: Sunday Afternoon: Annual Festival
cards.notes: Join the entire university community on the Quad for food trucks, live music, and activities to kick off the new school year.
cards.short_summary: The signature annual festival that brings together new and returning students to celebrate the start of classes.
cards.evidence_claim: DU Fest is held on Sunday from 3:00 PM to 6:00 PM on the Quad and is free for all DU students.
cards.source_title: Welcome Weekend Schedule at a Glance - Dominican University
cards.access_notes: Intended for students only (new and returning).

cards.title: Find Your Study Spot
cards.subtitle: Academic Hub
cards.notes: Visit the library to explore study rooms, the Learning Commons, and the Cyber Cafe located on the lower level.
cards.short_summary: The central academic resource center on campus, housing study spaces and student support services.
cards.evidence_claim: The Rebecca Crown Library includes the Learning Commons, study rooms, and the Cyber Cafe on the lower level.
cards.source_title: Dominican University Main Campus Map
cards.access_notes: Open daily; check LibCal for specific service desk hours.

cards.title: Stay Active on Campus
cards.subtitle: Athletic Facility
cards.notes: Check out the gym and suspended running track. It's open for student use during designated open gym hours.
cards.short_summary: A 15,000-square-foot gymnasium that serves as the home for varsity sports and recreational activities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Igini Sports Forum is open to all current students during open gym hours and features a suspended running track.
cards.source_title: Igini Sports Forum - Facilities - Dominican University Athletics
cards.access_notes: Requires a valid Dominican Star Card for entry.

cards.title: Reflect at the Grotto
cards.subtitle: Peaceful Landmark
cards.notes: Visit this historic campus landmark for a moment of quiet reflection or to enjoy the beautiful landscaping and waterfall.
cards.short_summary: A historic site on the northwest corner of campus used for prayer, reflection, and quiet contemplation since 1929.
cards.evidence_claim: The Our Lady of Lourdes Grotto is located in the northwest corner of the River Forest campus and has been a place of reflection since 1929.
cards.source_title: The Grotto: A Place of Prayer and Peace for Nearly a Century | Dominican University
cards.access_notes: Open to the public and university community daily.
